mapper.select:
select doi.sku_no, doi.item_name, doi.brand_id, doi.brand_name, doi.category_id, doi.category_name, doio.charge_id, doio.charge_name, doi.new_sign, doi.quantity, doi.sell_price, doio.platform_create_time from dmp_order_item doi left join dmp_order_info doio on doi.order_id = doio.id where doio.platform_create_time is not null and (to_char(doio.platform_create_time,'YYYY') = to_char(CURRENT_DATE,'YYYY') or to_char(doio.platform_create_time,'YYYYMM') = to_char(CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '-1 MONTH','YYYYMM'))
${dto.param}
